verdict.rationale: Pulley documents bulk loading of historical securities during onboarding: a cap table Excel template that becomes the source of truth, plus a Carta import handled by Pulley's onboarding team, which populates the complete cap table history. There is no evidence of ongoing self-serve bulk issuance of new grants (e.g. batch option grants), and the Carta path is a team-assisted email process rather than a product feature. Missing for 10: bulk issuance of new grants after onboarding, documented self-serve batch upload of transactions beyond initial migration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
